These agree with the preflight's recorded packet_input_pins and direct hashes. The preflight reports PREFLIGHT_READY_NO_CARGO, cargo_spawned=false, nextest_spawned=false, tests_run=false, network_used=false, 59 source-derived tests, no filter, and the matching runner/runplan/manifest/request/checksum hashes.
